transcript.text: Hi everyone. Thanks for joining the go-live review for the self-serve API-key rotation workflow. As we know, staging tests passed and we're targeting production launch next Monday. The current draft policy enables the workflow for all eligible customers, gives a 24-hour transition period, provides no advance customer notice, and retains ordinary rotation logs for 30 days. Before I give final approval, I need to hear from each of you — backend engineering, customer success, and security — on any operational or customer-facing requirements or concerns you have with this policy as it stands. Let's go through each area.

commitments.detail: Revise the draft policy to extend the client transition period from 24 hours to 48 hours to satisfy the backend engineering idempotency grace period requirement for legacy clients.
Revise the draft policy to require 14 calendar days' advance customer notice for Northstar before any API-key policy change affecting its integrations, per the Northstar enterprise agreement.
Revise the draft policy to store privileged key-rotation events in immutable audit storage for 365 days instead of retaining ordinary rotation logs for 30 days.

Postpone the production launch from next Monday to a date that is at least 14 calendar days after formal advance notice is provided to Northstar, with all three policy revisions incorporated and verified.
Leila to formally add the Northstar 14-day advance notice clause to the launch document.
Ravi to formally open the security finding for the 365-day immutable audit storage requirement and update launch documentation accordingly.
Ethan to update the launch ticket with the 48-hour idempotency grace period requirement for legacy clients.
